sanskrit: saṃ bhago varcasā māgne saṃ viṣṇuḥ puṣṭyā sicat | kṣatraṃ sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca- -āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu mā ||
english: May Bhaga pour lustre upon me, O Agni; may Viṣṇu pour nourishment. May Kṣatra drench us with progeny and wealth — may he make me long-lived.

sanskrit: saṃ virāḍ varcasā māgne saṃ deṣṭrī puṣṭyā sicat | iḍā sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca- -āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu mā ||
english: May Virāj pour lustre upon me, O Agni; may Deṣṭrī pour nourishment. May Iḍā drench us with progeny and wealth — may she make me long-lived.

sanskrit: saṃ dhātā varcasā māgne saṃ siktiḥ puṣṭyā sicat | saṃ devo asmān aryamā prajayā ca dhanena ca- -āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu mā ||
english: May Dhātā pour lustre upon me, O Agni; may Sikti pour nourishment. May the god Aryamā drench us with progeny and wealth — may he make me long-lived.

sanskrit: sam aṃśo varcasā māgne saṃ vāyuḥ puṣṭyā sicat | vātaḥ sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca- -āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu mā ||
english: May Aṃśa pour lustre upon me, O Agni; may Vāyu pour nourishment. May Vāta drench us with progeny and wealth — may he make me long-lived.

sanskrit: saṃ sabhā varcasā māgne saṃ surā puṣṭyā sicat | sūryā sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca- -āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu mā ||
english: May the assembly-hall (Sabhā) pour lustre upon me, O Agni; may Surā pour nourishment. May Sūryā drench us with progeny and wealth — may she make me long-lived.

sanskrit: saṃ savitā varcasā māgne saṃ sūryaḥ puṣṭyā sicat | candraḥ sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca- -āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu mā ||
english: May Savitā pour lustre upon me, O Agni; may Sūrya pour nourishment. May the Moon (Candra) drench us with progeny and wealth — may he make me long-lived.

sanskrit: saṃ paśavo varcasā māgne saṃ yajñaḥ puṣṭyā sicat | dakṣiṇā sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca- -āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu mā ||
english: May the cattle pour lustre upon me, O Agni; may sacrifice pour nourishment. May the sacrificial fee (Dakṣiṇā) drench us with progeny and wealth — may she make me long-lived.

sanskrit: saṃ mā siñcatu draviṇaṃ saṃ mā siñcatv indriyam | tejaḥ sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca- -āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu mā ||
english: May wealth drench me; may vital power drench me. May radiance (tejas) drench us with progeny and wealth — may it make me long-lived.

sanskrit: saṃ mā siñcantu varcāṃsi saṃ mā siñcantu bhūtayaḥ | satyaṃ sam asmān siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca- -āyuṣmantaṃ kṛṇotu mā ||
english: May the lustres drench me; may the powers of being drench me. May Truth (Satya) drench us with progeny and wealth — may it make me long-lived.

sanskrit: ā rātri pārthivaṃ rajaḥ pitur aprāyi dhāmabhiḥ | divaḥ sadāṃsi bṛhatī vi tiṣṭhasa ā tveṣaṃ vartate tamaḥ ||
english: O Night, the earthly dust has been filled by the father's abodes. O vast one, thou art spread across the seats of heaven; the thick darkness rolls on.

sanskrit: na yasyāḥ pāraṃ dadṛśe na yoyuvad viśvam asyāṃ ni viśate yad ejati | ariṣṭāsas ta urvi tamasvati rātri pāram aśīmahi bhadre pāram aśīmahi ||
english: Of her whose farther shore is never seen, nor any who departs — all that stirs enters into her. Unharmed, O Night wide and dark, may we reach thy farther shore; O auspicious one, may we reach thy farther shore.

sanskrit: ye te rātri nṛcakṣaso draṣṭāro navatir nava | aśītiḥ santy aṣṭā uto te sapta saptatiḥ ||
english: Those watchmen of thine, O Night, who look upon men — ninety and nine they are; eighty-eight, and further thy seventy-seven.

sanskrit: ṣaṣṭiś ca ṣaṭ ca revati pañcāśat pañca sumnayi | catvāraś catvāriṃśac ca trayas triṃśac ca vājini ||
english: Sixty-six, O bountiful one; fifty-five, O gracious one; four and forty; and three and thirty, O vigorous one.

sanskrit: dvā ca viṃśatiś ca te rātry ekādaśāvamāḥ | tebhir no 'dya pāyubhir ni pāhi duhitar divaḥ ||
english: Two and twenty are thine, O Night; the lowest eleven — with these guardians of thine protect us today, O daughter of heaven.

sanskrit: rakṣā mākir ṇo aghaśaṃsa īśata mā no duḥśaṃsa īśata ||
english: Protect us! Let no evil-proclaimer hold sway over us; let no ill-intentioned one hold sway over us.

sanskrit: mā no adya gavāṃ steno māvīnāṃ vṛka īśata | māśvānāṃ bhadre taskaro mā nṛṇāṃ yātudhānyaḥ ||
english: Let no thief of cattle hold sway over us today; let no wolf among the sheep hold sway. Let no robber of horses, O auspicious one, nor sorcerers among men hold sway.

sanskrit: paramebhiḥ pathibhi steno dhāvatu taskaraḥ | pareṇa datvatī rajjuḥ pareṇāghāyur arṣatu ||
english: Let the thief, the robber, run away by the farthest paths. Let the toothless rope flow beyond; let the evil-liver stream away beyond.

sanskrit: andhaṃ rātri tiṣṭhadhūmam aśīrṣāṇam ahiṃ kṛṇu | hanū vṛkasya jambhaya- -ā stenaṃ drupade jahi ||
english: Make the serpent blind, O Night, stationary like smoke, and headless. Crush the jaws of the wolf; strike down the thief in a stumble.

sanskrit: tvayi rātri vasāmasi svapiṣyāmasi jāgṛhi | gobhyo naḥ śarma yaccha- -aśvebhyaḥ puruṣebhyaḥ ||
english: In thee, O Night, we dwell; we shall sleep — keep watch! Grant us shelter for our cattle, for our horses, for our men.

sanskrit: atho yāni ca vasmahe yāni cāntaḥ parīṇahi | tāni te pari dadmasi ||
english: And what we wear, and what thou encirclest within — all that we surrender to thee.

sanskrit: rātri mātar uṣase naḥ pari dehi | uṣā no ahne pari dadātv ahas tubhyaṃ vibhāvari ||
english: O Night, O mother, deliver us over to Dawn. May Dawn deliver us over to the Day; O Day, deliver thyself to her, O bright-shining Night.

sanskrit: yat kiṃ cedaṃ patayati yat kiṃ cedaṃ sarīsṛpam | yat kiṃ ca padvad āsanvat tasmāt tvaṃ rātri pāhi naḥ ||
english: Whatever flies here, whatever crawls here, whatever walks on feet or has a mouth — from that do thou, O Night, protect us.

sanskrit: sā paścāt pāhi sā puraḥ sottarād adharād uta | gopāya no vibhāvari stotāras ta iha smasi ||
english: She protects from behind; she protects from before; and from above and below. Guard us, O bright-shining one — we are thy praisers here.

sanskrit: ye rātrim anutiṣṭhanti ye ca bhūteṣu jāgrati | paśūn ye sarvān rakṣanti te na ātmasu jāgratu te naḥ paśuṣu jāgratu ||
english: Those who attend upon the Night and who keep vigil among living beings, who guard all the cattle — may they keep vigil in our own selves; may they keep vigil over our cattle.

sanskrit: veda vai rātri te nāma ghṛtācī nāma vā asi | tāṃ tvā bharadvājo veda sā no vitte 'dhi jāgṛhi ||
english: I know thy name, O Night — Ghṛtācī is indeed thy name. Bharadvāja knows thee by that name; as such, watch over us, keep vigil in our possessions.
